title: YouTuber Block Telugu Edition
description: A fun Minecraft mod featuring famous Telugu YouTubers, custom blocks, and epic bosses like Evil YouTube
body:
🔥 Featured Telugu YouTubers & Their Items
🗡️ Maddy Telugu Gamer's Sword

Summons a protective mob called Laddu

Laddu will protect you from enemies if you feed him a KitKat

Fast attack and glowing effects

🔨 Hi5 Gamer's Hammer

Right-click to summon lightning strikes like Thor's power

High durability and knockback

⛏️ The Cosmic Boy's Pickaxe

Mines 10 blocks at once

Super efficiency and auto-smelting

Great for fast strip mining

🏹 YeshCrazy's Crossbow

Shoots explosive TNT arrows

Has a cool-down but deals massive AOE damage

⛏️ GMK Telugu Gamer's Shovel

Mines 10 dirt/sand blocks instantly

Grants Saturation effect while held, perfect for exploration

👾 New Mobs
📺 YouTube Monster

Randomly spawns at night

Attacks players with "Buffering Blasts"

Drops random YouTube loot

🐉 YouTube Dragon

Rare and powerful mob

Breathes fire and explodes when hurt

Drops XP and mod-exclusive items

👹 Evil YouTube (Boss)

Spawns via special structure or command

High health, multiple attack phases

Drops exclusive loot from all YouTubers

Can summon YouTube Monsters as minions

📦 Installation
Forge 1.20.1 is required.

Just place the .jar file in your mods folder.

Compatible with most standard Forge mods.

🏆 Why Download This Mod?
Telugu Gaming Community Pride

Unique & Custom Weapons

Mob-Summoning Features

TNT Arrows and Lightning Abilities

A full-fledged Boss Fight

Fun for survival & creative modes

🔧 Planned Features (Coming Soon)
Custom YouTuber Dimensions

New Foods and Structures

More YouTuber-themed Armor Sets

Voice lines or sound effects from creators
